brief.summary: Day 1 pack (built 18:05 IST from live research in your Chrome). Account: @creasivestudio, 1 follower, recent posts 1-24 views. At this size original posts barely get shown, so REPLIES under big accounts are the main growth lever this week. Do the replies first, then post.

trends.name: Seedance 2.5 + Opus 5.5 AI video
trends.why: @EHuanglu 1.3M views, @xmliisu 1.55M views in 48h. Whole creative X is posting clips and arguing about cost
trends.angle: AI for the vibe, 3D for the exact product. You are the person who can say where each wins

trends.name: Nothing x Taehyung (V) headphone ad + Nothing Phone (4a) promoted in India
trends.why: IG collab post at 5M likes / 1.1M shares, being discussed on X; Phone (4a) is the promoted trend in India today
trends.angle: Spec 3D ad for Nothing's glyph lights (render request R1). The brand's fans repost spec ads

trends.name: 'freelance = maybe unemployed' joke
trends.angle: Own the joke from the freelancer side, ask a question that every freelancer can answer

trends.name: Y2K 3D aesthetic nostalgia
trends.why: @Jeff_in_3D 1.33M views on an account with 1.9k followers (700x his normal)
trends.angle: Rebuild a modern D2C product in that exact tacky Y2K style (render request R2)

trends.name: 'Logos redrawn by memory' design experiment
trends.angle: Brand lesson: if customers can't draw it, it isn't working

brief.golden_hour: Golden hour = the 30-60 min after each post. Reply to every comment fast and ask a follow-up question: the author replying to replies is the strongest ranking signal X has.
checklist: One-time (10 min): join the 11 X Communities listed in knowledge/viral-playbook.md (links there). The agent never joins for you.
One-time: turn on the post-notification bell for @EHuanglu, @PJaccetturo, @andrewpprice, @iProee, @buildwithsid, @southernshotty, @TidalDrawZZ so you're first to reply.
One-time: fix the profile (bio, pinned post, banner, name field 'Ishaan | 3D ads'). Options in memory/weekly/day1-report.md.
Now: post 3-5 replies from 'Replies first'. Use 'Reply with option N', no hashtags in replies.
18:30: post P1 with its image + alt text, then share it to the Generative AI community. Stay 30 min and answer every comment (ready replies under the post).
21:30: P2 + share to The Design Sphere. Same golden-hour routine.
Tomorrow 09:30: P3. Monday 18:30: P4 free-ad giveaway, then pin it.
Within 48 h: make render request R1 (Nothing Phone 4a spec ad) and tag @nothing when posting. Real renders beat every generated image.

posts.hypothesis: Taking a clear side on the week's biggest creative trend earns replies from both camps
posts.text:
everyone's posting seedance 2.5 clips this week. they look insane.

now make one where a brand's real product, exact cap and label, stays identical in every frame.

that gap is the whole 3D ad business now.

AI for the vibe. 3D for the product.

#AIvideo #b3d
posts.media: Attach: media/2026-10-04_P1_ai-vs-3d.jpg (or your sharpest real product render)
alt_hooks: seedance 2.5 can make anything. except your client's actual product.
AI video got scary good this week. here's the one thing clients still pay 3D studios for:
posts.alt_text: Two 3D bottles on a dark stage. Left: a warped, glitching AI-style bottle with a smeared, misspelled label. Right: a clean black bottle with a crisp white EVOLVE label. Text: AI for the vibe, 3D for the product.
golden_hour_replies: fair, for moodboards and pitches AI wins on speed. we use it there too
the day it holds a label for 15 seconds without drifting, i'll switch. not this week
which one have you seen hold a real product best so far?
3D still loses on speed. that's the honest trade

posts.hypothesis: A design experiment people already love, turned into a test brands can run, gets bookmarks + replies
posts.text:
the 'logos redrawn by memory' experiment is the best brand test nobody runs.

ask 10 customers to draw your logo. no peeking.

if nobody gets close, it isn't a logo. it's decoration.

which brand logo could you draw perfectly right now?

#branding #logodesign
alt_hooks: draw your logo from memory. if your customers can't, it's decoration.
posts.alt_text: Left: a messy tangle of chrome tubes labeled decoration. Right: one clean purple rounded square with a circle cut out, labeled a logo. Text: Draw your logo from memory.
golden_hour_replies: nike and apple, every time. one shape each
the test works on packaging too. can they draw your bottle?
most rebrands fail this test on day one
drop yours, i'll tell you honestly if it passes

posts.hypothesis: A relatable freelancer truth + an easy question gets replies from every freelancer who sees it
posts.text:
saw a viral joke that freelancers have a non zero chance of being unemployed.

it's worse. freelancing is being unemployed on the 1st of every month until someone pays an invoice.

what's the longest you've gone between paid projects?

#freelance #freelancelife
alt_hooks: freelancing is being unemployed until someone pays an invoice.
posts.alt_text: A curled paper invoice stamped UNPAID floating between gold coins. Line items include revisions round 6 for 0.00. Text: Freelancing is being unemployed until someone pays an invoice.
golden_hour_replies: 50% upfront fixed most of this for us. still not all of it
the 'seen day 3' is the part that hurts
net 30 really means net 60, nobody told me
what made you finally start charging a deposit?

posts.hypothesis: A free-ad giveaway pulls replies from brands (leads) and gives the account a reason to follow
posts.text:
free 3D ad, this week.

reply with your brand (any D2C product, any size).

i'll pick one and turn a product photo from your site into a 3D ad. no call, no catch.

the finished ad goes up right here.

#DTC #b3d
posts.alt_text: Glossy purple 3D blob with a glass sphere and chrome ring on a dark stage. Text: Your product. Our 3D. Free. Reply with your brand.
golden_hour_replies: love this one, what's the product photo you'd want us to use?
noted. picking on friday, every reply counts
tag a founder who needs this
alt_hooks: your product, our 3D, free. reply with your brand.

quotes.author: @Jeff_in_3D
quotes.why: 1.33M views, Y2K 3D nostalgia, our exact craft. Quote early in the US day
quotes.text:
it was tacky then. now brands pay for this look on purpose.

rebuilding a modern product in this exact style this week. will post it here.

quotes.author: @juliarturc
quotes.why: 73k views, 179 replies, AI video cost debate, 10h old and still active
quotes.text:
the unit economics only work for vibes.

the second a client says 'make the label match our packaging in every shot', you're back to 3D, where the 40th revision costs electricity, not credits.

replies.author: @Ciri_ai
replies.target_text: smartest place to spend AI video credits is AFTER you've made the creative decision
replies.why: 12k views, AI video crowd, we add a 3D-production angle
options:
same rule saves 3D jobs.

we lock camera and timing in a grey box before a single final render. clients approve the blockout, not the pixels.
this is the old previs rule wearing a new outfit. decide the shot cheap, render it once.
the expensive part was never the render. it's the 'can we try one more angle' after it.

replies.author: @juliarturc
replies.target_text: video generation IS EXPENSIVE. $8 for 15s of unsalvageable garbage 720p draft
replies.why: 179 replies, the cost debate is our home turf. Use if you don't quote it
options:
the hidden cost is the reroll.

in 3D the 40th revision of the same shot costs electricity. in AI it costs the same as the first.
most AI slop is made by people who never had a client ask for the exact label in frame 3.

replies.author: @houmi_art
replies.target_text: Hot take: honest artists can easily prove their innocence with WIPs
replies.why: artist community debate; WIPs = our breakdown content, natural fit
options: WIPs are the new portfolio. clients ask us for the wireframe before they ask for the final now.
a breakdown is the one thing a generator can't fake yet. post them even when nobody asks.

replies.author: @0bNARA
replies.target_text: when someone tells you they are freelance there's a non zero chance they are just entirely unemployed
replies.why: 26k views; a funny freelancer reply can pick up profile clicks
options: it's a quantum state. unemployed until the client replies to the invoice email.

replies.author: @OmaeOkara
replies.target_text: POV: Bring those OCD clients. I am the OCD contractor. clear lines and angles
replies.why: 96k views, craft pride, any creative relates
options: every client who said 'it's fine, nobody will notice' noticed.
the OCD client and the OCD contractor are the only people who ever ship something clean.
